evals.prompt: Scaffold a new modular skill for Docker container hardening following progressive disclosure and quality standards.
evals.expected_output: Produces a modular skill bundle with SKILL.md under 500 lines, imperative description, and a Gotchas section.
assertions: Frontmatter contains name matching directory regex
Includes ## Gotchas section with non-obvious traps
Offloads deep specs to references/ rather than bloating SKILL.md

evals.prompt: Validate an existing skill directory for spec compliance using the bundled validator tool.
evals.expected_output: Executes validate_skill.py, checks frontmatter and evals schema, and outputs structured JSON report.
assertions: Emits valid JSON report with valid boolean and stats
